note: First-ever score for this category. Design: single tile, reactive skip-and-remember companion servicing, no dedicated wood investment -- wood accumulates for free from ordinary companion churn (harvesting a now-mature standing Bush/Tree on a type mismatch), unlocking Carrot around cycle ~15-25 of a run. Multi-tile is closed (001: no idle time to hide; 005: self-collision at useful overlap distances; 006: a commute tax at safe distances that beats any sharing benefit). Measured ~55.8 hay/tick average across the scored run's 25 internal repeats, ~2.1x off the leader. See experiments/hay_single/00{1..8}/result.md and queue.md for the full trail.
